subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this conflicting iOS onboarding branch be rebased and narrowed around its remaining secure Tailscale/auth behavior, or closed in favor of current main plus narrower follow-up work?
rationale: The PR is protected by the maintainer label, conflicts with a recently merged onboarding refresh, and changes security-sensitive setup policy, so cleanup automation should not close or reshape it without maintainer intent.
